overview: This enum selects the behavior profile that controls a summoned shikigami and its bone controller.

None.simple: No specific summon behavior is selected.
None.technical: The row constructor uses None. CreateActionController has no None case, so the switch reaches its default branch and creates UGameShikigamiActionController. CreateBoneController also reaches its default branch and creates UGameShikigamiBoneController.

CN_010.simple: This summon uses the CN_010 behavior, which follows above its owner and appears in a diagonal group.
CN_010.technical: CreateActionController creates UCN_010_ActionController, sets FollowHeightOffset to 100.0 Unreal units, sets SummonOffset to (-100, -100, 0), and enables bSummonFormationEnabled. CreateBoneController creates UCN_010_BoneController.

CN_020.simple: This summon uses the CN_020 behavior and appears in a diagonal group.
CN_020.technical: CreateActionController creates UCN_020_ActionController, leaves FollowHeightOffset at 0.0, sets SummonOffset to (-100, -100, 0), and enables bSummonFormationEnabled. CreateBoneController creates UCN_020_BoneController.

CN_030.simple: This summon uses the CN_030 behavior, which stays close without orders or pushback movement.
CN_030.technical: CreateActionController creates UCN_030_ActionController, leaves FollowHeightOffset at 0.0, and disables bPushbackMovable, bFollowProbeScheduleEnabled, and bOrdersEnabled. CreateBoneController has no CN_030 case, so it creates UGameShikigamiBoneController.

CN_040.simple: This summon uses the CN_040 behavior and appears in a diagonal group.
CN_040.technical: CreateActionController creates UCN_040_ActionController, leaves FollowHeightOffset at 0.0, sets SummonOffset to (-100, -100, 0), and enables bSummonFormationEnabled. CreateBoneController creates UCN_040_BoneController.

CN_050.simple: This summon uses the CN_050 behavior, with several variant rows sharing the same controller profile.
CN_050.technical: CreateActionController creates UCN_050_ActionController, leaves FollowHeightOffset at 0.0, and disables bPushbackMovable, bFollowProbeScheduleEnabled, bPlacementProcessingEnabled, bGroundSnapEnabled, bOrdersEnabled, and bSuppressCollisionRelease. CreateBoneController creates UCN_050_BoneController.

CN_070.simple: This summon uses the CN_070 behavior, which disables orders and formation placement.
CN_070.technical: CreateActionController creates UCN_070_ActionController, leaves FollowHeightOffset at 0.0, and disables bPushbackMovable, bFollowProbeScheduleEnabled, bOrdersEnabled, and bSummonFormationEnabled. CreateBoneController has no CN_070 case, so it creates UGameShikigamiBoneController.

CN_080.simple: This summon uses the CN_080 behavior and appears in a diagonal group.
CN_080.technical: CreateActionController creates UCN_080_ActionController, leaves FollowHeightOffset at 0.0, sets SummonOffset to (-100, -100, 0), and enables bSummonFormationEnabled. CreateBoneController has no CN_080 case, so it creates UGameShikigamiBoneController.

CN_110.simple: This summon uses the CN_110 behavior, which follows without orders and throttles follow updates.
CN_110.technical: CreateActionController creates UCN_110_ActionController, leaves FollowHeightOffset at 0.0, disables bOrdersEnabled, and enables bThrottlesFollowUpdates. CreateBoneController has no CN_110 case, so it creates UGameShikigamiBoneController.

CN_180.simple: This summon uses the CN_180 behavior, with movement placement and orders disabled.
CN_180.technical: CreateActionController creates UCN_180_ActionController, leaves FollowHeightOffset at 0.0, and disables bPushbackMovable, bFollowProbeScheduleEnabled, bPlacementProcessingEnabled, bGroundSnapEnabled, bOrdersEnabled, and bSuppressCollisionRelease. CreateBoneController creates UCN_180_BoneController.

CN_200.simple: This summon uses the CN_200 behavior, which disables orders and formation placement.
CN_200.technical: CreateActionController creates UCN_200_ActionController, leaves FollowHeightOffset at 0.0, and disables bPushbackMovable, bFollowProbeScheduleEnabled, bOrdersEnabled, and bSummonFormationEnabled. CreateBoneController has no CN_200 case, so it creates UGameShikigamiBoneController.

CN_220.simple: This summon uses the CN_220 behavior, which follows above its owner without an activation collision reset.
CN_220.technical: CreateActionController creates UCN_220_ActionController, sets FollowHeightOffset to 100.0 Unreal units, enables bSkipActivationCollisionReset, and sets SummonOffset to (0, 0, 0). CreateBoneController creates UCN_220_BoneController.

CN_231.simple: This summon uses the CN_231 behavior and rotates its attached effect.
CN_231.technical: CreateActionController creates UCN_231_ActionController, leaves FollowHeightOffset at 0.0, enables bSummonFormationEnabled, and sets SummonOffset to (-100, -100, 0). When EffectController exists, AttachRotation becomes FRotator(0.0, 90.0, 0.0). CreateBoneController creates UCN_231_BoneController.

CN_270.simple: This summon uses the CN_270 behavior, with movement placement and orders disabled.
CN_270.technical: CreateActionController creates UCN_270_ActionController, leaves FollowHeightOffset at 0.0, and disables bPushbackMovable, bFollowProbeScheduleEnabled, bPlacementProcessingEnabled, bGroundSnapEnabled, bOrdersEnabled, and bSuppressCollisionRelease. CreateBoneController creates UCN_270_BoneController.

CN_272.simple: This summon uses the CN_272 behavior, with movement placement and orders disabled.
CN_272.technical: CreateActionController creates UCN_272_ActionController, leaves FollowHeightOffset at 0.0, and disables bPushbackMovable, bFollowProbeScheduleEnabled, bPlacementProcessingEnabled, bGroundSnapEnabled, bOrdersEnabled, and bSuppressCollisionRelease. CreateBoneController creates UCN_272_BoneController.

CN_280.simple: This summon uses the CN_280 behavior, with movement placement and orders disabled.
CN_280.technical: CreateActionController creates UCN_280_ActionController, leaves FollowHeightOffset at 0.0, and disables bPushbackMovable, bFollowProbeScheduleEnabled, bPlacementProcessingEnabled, bGroundSnapEnabled, bOrdersEnabled, and bSuppressCollisionRelease. CreateBoneController creates UCN_280_BoneController.

Invalid.simple: No valid summon profile is selected.
Invalid.technical: CreateActionController has no Invalid case, so the switch reaches its default branch and creates UGameShikigamiActionController. CreateBoneController also reaches its default branch and creates UGameShikigamiBoneController.

notes: The row field is passed to both controller factories during AGameShikigami::Setup, and a false result from either factory or from CreateMaterialController makes Setup fail.
The read-only ShikigamiDataTable export uses CN_050 for rows CN_050, CN_051, CN_052, CN_050_10, CN_051_10, and CN_052_10.
CN_070, CN_080, CN_110, and CN_200 select specialized action controllers. Those values use the generic bone controller because CreateBoneController has no case for them.
